collection.description: The Rosetta Stone (British Museum EA 24, 196 BCE): the complete Greek text of the priests' decree for Ptolemy V, 54 lines in groups of six, each cut from the British Museum's photograph of the stone, with Budge's 1904 English.

texts.title: The Rosetta Stone: Greek text of the Memphis decree (complete, lines 1-54)
texts.source: Rosetta Stone, British Museum EA 24 (British Museum photograph of 1922, public domain, via Wikimedia Commons) + Greek transcript and English rendering of E. A. Wallis Budge, The Decrees of Memphis and Canopus, vol. 2 (1904, public domain)
texts.description: The complete Greek text of the Rosetta Stone (196 BCE), the priests' decree for Ptolemy V, line by line on the photograph of the stone, with Budge's 1904 English.

pages.caption: The Rosetta Stone, front (Hans Hillewaert, CC BY-SA 4.0)

authors.name: Synod of Egyptian priests at Memphis
authors.bio: The assembly of high priests, prophets and scribes from the temples of Egypt that met at Memphis for the coronation of Ptolemy V and passed the decree copied on the Rosetta Stone.
